reason: Batch 003 source audit replaced unsupported agency/mandate and procurement assertions with source-backed RA 9266, Civil Code Article 1723, RA 9184, RA 7160/COA, RA 11201, and EO 90 framing.

proposed.text: When a private consultant works with a government in-house design team, what must the agreement and project record make clear?

options.text: That the in-house office automatically becomes architect-of-record for all drawings
That responsibility follows the signed and sealed architectural documents, review authority, and approved procurement/contract role
That RA 9184 replaces professional responsibility under RA 9266
That Article 1723 applies only to private-sector projects

proposed.rationale: Responsibility allocation follows who prepared, reviewed, signed, sealed, and approved which documents.
proposed.explanation: This removes the unsupported design-build/design-bid-build premise and aligns the question with RA 9266, Article 1723, and RA 9184.
proposed.code_citation: RA 9266 IRR; Civil Code Article 1723; RA 9184
